content: KAUN-O ketin Inoukihda Onohnsapahl en Serusalem
KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap, ketikihong Sekaraia mahsen wet:
“I ngoangkilahr I en sewese Serusalem pwehki ei limpokohng mehlel nah aramas akan, soangen limpoak ehu me kin kahrehda ei engieng pahn eh imwintihti kan.
I pahn sapahldohng Serusalem, ei kahnimw sarawio, oh ketiket wasao. E pahn adanekihla kahnimw loalopwoat; oh dohl en KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap,
pahn adanekihla dohl sarawi.
Ohl laud kan oh lih laud kan, me likeilapalahr douluhl oh kin sokon, pahn pwurehng mwomwohdseli ni wasahn tuhpenehn aramas akan en kahnimwo.
Oh nanial akan pahn pwurehng diren kisin pwutak oh serepein me pahn mwadomwadongseli.
“Met mwomwen me e sohte pahn pweida ong tohn wehio kan me luhwehdi, ahpw ong ie e kak pweida.
I pahn kapitala nei aramas akan sang nan sahpw akan me re wisiklahngehr ie,
oh I pahn kapwureiraildo sang palimese oh palikapi pwe re en kousoanla Serusalem. Re pahn wiahla nei aramas, oh I pahn wiahla ar Koht, me pahn kakaun irail ni loalopwoat oh pwung.
“Kumwail nan kapehd kehlail! Met kumwail pil rongorong soangen mahsen kante me soukohp ako kohpada ni ahnsou me poahsoan en Tehnpas Sarawio koasoansoandi ni ahnsoun onohnsapahl en Tehnpesei Sarawio.
Mwohn ahnsowo sohte emen me kak koadoadoahkih aramas emen de mahn emen, oh sohte me saledek sang eh imwintihti kan. I kupwurehda pwe aramas akan en uhpene nanpwungarail.
Ahpw met I wiahiong me mourla kan en wehiet mehkot me weksang me I wiahiongehr mehn mahs ako.

Re pahn padokedi ar wahnsahpw ni popohl. Ar tuhkehn wain kan pahn wa, pwelen sampah pahn kapwarehda wahnsahpw, oh keteu pahn rek. I pahn ketikihong kupwuramwahu pwukat ong aramas akan en ei wehi me mourlahr.

Kumwail mehn Suda oh Israel! Mahs mehn liki kan kin keriahla emen ni ar kin nda, ‘Soangen apwal me lelohng Suda oh Israel en pil lelohng kumwail!’ Ahpw I pahn kapitkumwailla, oh mehn liki pwuko pahn ndapene nanpwungarail, ‘Kumwail en ale soangen kupwuramwahu me kohieng Suda oh Israel!’ Eri, kumwail nan kapehd kehlail oh dehr masak mehkot.”
KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap, mahsanih, “Ni ahnsou me amwail pahpa kahlap ako kahngiangihiehda, I koasoanehdi I en ketikihong irail kahpwal laud oh I sohte wekidala kupwurei, ahpw I kapwaiada.
Ahpw met I koasoakoasone I en kupwuramwahwihala mehn Serusalem oh Suda. Eri, kumwail dehr masak mehkot.
Iet me kumwail pahn wia: Lokaia mehlelpene nanpwungamwail. Kasalehda pwuhng mehlel nan mwoalen kopwung—pwuhng me kin kahrehda popohl.
Kumwail dehr wiahda koasoandi me pahn kauwehla emenemen. Dehr kahukihla kadehde likamw. I kalahdeki lokaia likamw, pwuhng sapahrek, oh kamaramas.”
KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap, ketikihong Sekaraia mahsen wet:
“Kaisihsol me kin wiawi ni kapahieu, kelimau, keisuh, oh kaeisek en sounpwong pahn wiahla sarawien peren oh nsenamwahu ong mehn Suda. Kumwail en poakohng me mehlel oh popohl.”
KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap, mahsanih, “Ahnsowo pahn kohdo me aramas akan sang nan kahnimw tohto pahn kohdo nan Serusalem.
Irail kan me kohsang nan ehu kahnimw pahn ndahng me kohsang nan kahnimw teikan, ‘Kitail pahn kaudokiong KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap, oh peki sapwellime kupwuramwahu. Kumwail kohdo iang kiht!’
Aramas oh wehi kehlail tohto pahn kohdo Serusalem pwe re en kaudokiong KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap, oh peki sapwellime kupwuramwahu.
Ni rahn pwuko mehn liki ehk pahn kohdo rehn mehn Suhs men oh nda, ‘Se pahn ianguhkala nan omw palien lamalam en, pwe se rong me Koht kin ketin ieiang uhk.”
